summary: Osisko Development filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of an additional US$75 million aggregate principal amount of 4.125% convertible senior notes due 2031, including US$25 million from the full exercise of initial purchasers' option and US$50 million from a concurrent private placement with Double Zero Capital, LP. Combined with the previously announced US$225 million base offering, total gross proceeds are US$300 million. Net proceeds fund development of the Cariboo Gold Project and general corporate purposes. The company purchased cash-settled capped calls to offset dilution, effectively increasing the conversion premium from 25% to 100%. Watch for execution milestones and share price relative to the conversion premium.
